summary:
## What's Changed
* Enable Qwen3-Omni multimodal batching by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2349
* Review/extraction test harness by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2394
* Fix broken CI: Qwen-compatible tokenizer in the processor regression test  by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2401
* Add Decider and the shared typed decision API by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2396
* Add Laya on the shared decision API by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2397
* Keep the most likely MoG component for a tiny top_p in Nemotron VoiceChat by @pierre427 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2405
* Stop gradients on MoE router selection indices (MLX >= 0.32.1) by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2409
* removing duplicate rotate_half and check_array_shape funcs by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2414
* Feat/decision cli by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2402
* Add conversation compaction to the Responses API by @Blaizzy in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2408
* Fix prequantized Qwen4 PLE loading by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2417
* Fix PhiMoE routing and plain RoPE configs by @Lazarus-931 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2419
* Compute top-p and typical-p probability mass in float32 by @pierre427 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2404
* qwen3_vl: take video timestamps from the frames that were actually sampled by @Marian2110 in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2413
* Bump version to 0.7.5 by @lucasnewman in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2432

## New Contributors
* @Marian2110 made their first contribution in https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/pull/2413

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm/compare/v0.7.4...v0.7.5
